unresolved.question: Page legend defines a band sign drawn like ২ as ইখফা (not দম ফেলিলে দুই আলিফ); used label ইখফা for the ২ signs in rows 0 and 4 (row 0 word 2 ن before ت; row 4 word 4 tanween before ذ).
Circled ১ (single ring) in row 2 over the final alif of اَفْوَاجًا and تَوَّابًا: labelled দম ফেলিলে এক আলিফ.
Row 4: ayah 111:3 end circle carries two stacked signs, صلے over ج; written as ۚ only.
Row 2: waqf sign after وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ is a small ط with an extra stroke; written as ؕ.
Surah 110 Bengali name spelling in the header box (নাছ্‌র্) is hard to read exactly.
ম/১ over اللّٰهُ (rows 1, 6) split between the two lams by x position (ম on letter 2, ১ on letter 3); both may be meant for the shadda lam.
